title: Grade Guarantee, Discount and Recheck Schedule, Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements
content:
What the elevator undertakes to give the member back at the end of storage is fixed by the programme, and so are the discount for each grade step short of it, the charge for a member-requested recheck and the longest billing may stand suspended. The schedule below covers all six programmes of Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## The schedule

| Programme | Grade the elevator returns the grain at | Discount for each full grade step (USD per bushel) | Recheck charge (USD) | Longest billing may stand suspended (days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | house average grade | 0.0300 | 25.00 | 30 |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | house average grade | 0.0300 | 25.00 | 30 |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | receipt grade | 0.0300 | 40.00 | 45 |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | receipt grade | 0.0300 | 40.00 | 45 |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | receipt grade | 0.0250 | 40.00 | 45 |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | delivered lot grade | 0.0500 | 60.00 | 20 |

## Notes

The three guarantees in the first column are distinct undertakings: the house average grade is the average grade of the house's own bin, the receipt grade is the grade written on the receipt issued against the grain, and the delivered lot grade is the member's own lot as it was delivered.

The heaviest discount for each grade step, 0.0500 for each bushel, stands against the programme that guarantees the delivered lot; the lightest, 0.0250, against the Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement.

The recheck charge rises with the catalogue, from 25.00 on the two lowest programmes through 40.00 in the middle to 60.00 on the Identity Preserved Segregated Storage.

The suspension maximum is 30 calendar days on the two lowest programmes, 45 on the three in the middle and 20 on the Identity Preserved Segregated Storage, which is the shortest in the catalogue despite being the highest programme.

## Worked figure, on hypothetical bushels

Ten thousand bushels returned two full grade steps below the guaranteed grade on a Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage attract 0.0300 for each bushel for each step: ten thousand multiplied by two steps multiplied by three hundredths of a dollar, which is 600.00. The same shortfall on an Identity Preserved Segregated Storage, at 0.0500 for each bushel for each step, comes to 1000.00.
